SELECT p.category, p.subcategory, p.valid_from, p.valid_to, count(*) versions, count(distinct p.sku) skus, (select count(*) from tmp_outdoor_lighting_skus) tmp_n,
 count(*) filter (where p.sku in (select sku from tmp_outdoor_lighting_skus)) in_tmp,
 min(p.listed_from) lf
FROM dim_product p WHERE p.subcategory='Outdoor Lighting' OR p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM tmp_outdoor_lighting_skus) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY valid_from

SELECT d.fiscal_period, p.category, p.subcategory, count(*) lines, count(distinct f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(*) filter (where f.staff_purchase_flag) staff, count(*) filter (where f.channel_code='WB') web, min(f.etl_loaded_at) mn, max(f.etl_loaded_at) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND (p.category='Garden' OR p.subcategory='Outdoor Lighting')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT 'ret' src, d.fiscal_period, count(*) n, count(distinct r.return_line_id) dn, sum(r.refund_net) amt, count(*) filter (where r.sales_line_id not in (select sales_line_id from fact_sales_line)) orphan, count(*) filter (where r.refund_net<0) neg
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND p.category='Garden' GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dups_sales', 0, count(*), count(distinct sales_line_id), sum(net_amount), count(*) filter (where abs(net_amount*(1+vat_rate)-gross_amount)>0.02), count(*) filter (where quantity<=0 or net_amount<0)
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dups_receipt_line', 0, count(*), count(distinct (receipt_id, line_no)), 0, 0, 0 FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'date_vs_ts', 0, count(*), count(*) filter (where cast(sale_ts_utc as date)<>sale_date), 0,0,0 FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ret_dups_in_fact_vs_stg', 0, (select count(*) from stg_return_line_load), (select count(*) from fact_return_line), 0,0,0
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH rng AS (SELECT DATE '2024-10-28' a, DATE '2025-04-27' b),
r AS (SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) bef, sum(returns_net) ret, sum(net_sales) ns, sum(receipts) rc FROM rpt_daily_store_sales, rng WHERE business_date BETWEEN a AND b),
s AS (SELECT sum(f.net_amount) all_net, sum(f.net_amount) filter (where channel_code='ST') st_net, sum(f.net_amount) filter (where channel_code='ST' and not staff_purchase_flag) st_nostaff, sum(f.net_amount) filter (where not staff_purchase_flag) all_nostaff, count(distinct receipt_id) filter (where channel_code='ST') st_rc FROM fact_sales_line f, rng WHERE sale_date BETWEEN a AND b),
t AS (SELECT sum(refund_net) all_ret, sum(refund_net) filter (where store_key in (select store_key from dim_store where store_id<900)) st_ret FROM fact_return_line, rng WHERE return_date BETWEEN a AND b),
l AS (SELECT count(*) late, count(*) filter (where hour(sale_ts_utc) between 20 and 23 or hour(sale_ts_utc)<=1) h FROM fact_sales_line, rng WHERE sale_date BETWEEN a AND b AND cast(sale_ts_utc as date)<>sale_date)
SELECT * FROM r, s, t, l

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.format, count(*) lines, sum(f.net_amount) net, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, count(*) filter (where d.is_trading_day=false) nontrading, count(*) filter (where f.sale_date > current_date) future
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE p.category='Garden' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-04-27' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (SELECT st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-04-27' AND st.store_id>=900 GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) bef, sum(returns_net) ret FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-04-27' AND store_id>=900 GROUP BY 1),
t AS (SELECT st.store_id, sum(refund_net) ret FROM fact_return_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.return_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-04-27' AND st.store_id>=900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(s.store_id,r.store_id) id, s.net fact_net, r.bef rpt_bef, t.ret fact_ret, r.ret rpt_ret FROM s FULL JOIN r ON s.store_id=r.store_id FULL JOIN t ON t.store_id=coalesce(s.store_id,r.store_id)

SELECT o.status, count(distinct o.web_order_id) orders, count(*) lines, sum(f.net_amount) net,
 sum(f.net_amount) filter (where p.category='Garden') garden_net,
 count(*) filter (where p.category='Garden') garden_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-04-27' AND f.channel_code='WB' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden' AND s.store_id <> 999
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
), rets AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, -r.refund_net AS amt
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden' AND s.store_id <> 999
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
)
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, 'Garden' AS category, round(sum(amt), 2) AS net_sales
FROM (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
